t_advice_summary_textbox.text: The knomes normally have the same scores in each round and the maximum is 45 so its a case of trying to remember the scores that specific knomes give you once you try. Repeat the high scoring knomes.

vb_textbox.text: The maximum on times 5 is 45 and the maximum on times 1 is 9 points. I tried to correlated the points with the certain colours and in the last round I found that playing orange, yellow, pink and blue worked very well for me getting high points.
